items.title: 6.11.3 Reactions mein entropy ki tabdeeliyan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.11.3, printed pages 137-138.

blocks.text: Reactants aur products ki entropies ka muqabla reaction ki entropy tabdeeli ke size aur nishan ko samjhata hai. Jab products mein solid liquid ya gas bane to entropy tabdeeli musbat hai; agar products mein moles zyada hon to entropy tabdeeli musbat hai; aur gaseous molecules ki tadaad mein tabdeeli sab se aham hai, kyunke gases ki entropies zyada hain, jitne zyada gas molecules utne zyada un ki tarteeb ke tareeqe. CaCO3(s) se CaO(s) + CO2(g) ke liye system ki entropy barhti hai kyunke solid (kam entropy) se gas (zyada entropy) banti hai; aisi reactions khud-ba-khud hain. 2N2O5(g) se 4NO2(g) + O2(g) ke liye entropy barhti hai kyunke products mein gas ke paanch moles hain reactants ke do ke muqable, yeh bhi khud-ba-khud amal hai. Chai mein shakar ka halna solute aur solvent dono ki entropy barhata hai.
Entropy tabdeeli ka nishan aur khud-ba-khudi

Kisi madde ki entropy hamesha musbat hai, magar entropy tabdeeli musbat ya manfi ho sakti hai. Musbat delta S ka matlab khud-ba-khud amal hai; manfi delta S zyada ba-tarteeb molecules aur be-tarteebi mein kami zahir karta hai. Magar kuch reactions ke liye entropy tabdeeli khud-ba-khudi nahi batati, aur ek aur miqdar, free energy, chahiye.

blocks.prompt: N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3 aur 2HI se H2 + I2 ke liye delta S ka nishan batayein, aur kahein ke in mein se kaun se ghaliban khud-ba-khud hain: kamre mein ammonia ki boo phailna, -10 degrees C par pani jamna, 20 degrees C par ethanol bukharat banna, namak ka pani se poori tarah milna, kamre ke darja hararat par limestone ka tootna.
blocks.explanation: Ammonia ka banna: gas ke chaar moles do bante hain, to delta S manfi. HI ka tootna: gas ke do moles do dete hain, to delta S taqreeban sifar (thora musbat, kyunke do mukhtalif gases banti hain). Khud-ba-khud: ammonia ki boo ka phailna, -10 degrees C par pani jamna, 20 degrees C par ethanol ka evaporate hona (aahista, khule bartan se) aur namak ka halna; limestone kamre ke darja hararat par nahi toot-ta.

items: Delta S musbat hai jab solid liquid ya gas bane, jab products mein zyada moles hon, aur sab se barh kar jab gas molecules ki tadaad barhe (CaCO3 se CaO + CO2; 2N2O5 se 4NO2 + O2); musbat delta S khud-ba-khudi ke haq mein hai, magar kuch reactions ko faisle ke liye free energy chahiye.
